excludeBeltWarning: Based on tests from some players, the game server may simplify belt-related calculations after you go offline. If you encounter abnormal production after going offline, try enabling "Exclude Belts" and rebuilding the production line using belt-free blueprints.
excludeItemGateLimiterHint:
Off (default) = rate-limited solving enabled, which can greatly reduce splitters and device load. On = ignore rate limits and use full-speed calculation.

Note: In-game item-gate "speed adjustment" unlocks after advancing the Wuling industrial plan and researching "flow-rate adjustment". The device itself is available earlier in Basic Industry Phase I.
